question: What was the percentage change in the median price between 2018 and 2025?
sql: WITH cpi_2025 AS (SELECT cpi AS cpi_2025 FROM cpi_annual WHERE year = 2025), median_by_year AS (SELECT sale_year, median(price) AS median_price, cpi_annual.cpi AS cpi_year FROM gm_sales JOIN cpi_annual ON gm_sales.sale_year = cpi_annual.year GROUP BY sale_year, cpi_annual.cpi) SELECT (median_2025_adj - median_2018_adj) / median_2018_adj * 100 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2025 THEN median_price * (cpi_2025.cpi_2025 / cpi_year) END) AS median_2025_adj, MAX(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2018 THEN median_price * (cpi_2025.cpi_2025 / cpi_year) END) AS median_2018_adj FROM median_by_year, cpi_2025) t;
raw: {"action":"query","sql":"WITH cpi_2025 AS (SELECT cpi AS cpi_2025 FROM cpi_annual WHERE year = 2025), median_by_year AS (SELECT sale_year, median(price) AS median_price, cpi_annual.cpi AS cpi_year FROM gm_sales JOIN cpi_annual ON gm_sales.sale_year = cpi_annual.year GROUP BY sale_year, cpi_annual.cpi) SELECT (median_2025_adj - median_2018_adj) / median_2018_adj * 100 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2025 THEN median_price * (cpi_2025.cpi_2025 / cpi_year) END) AS median_2025_adj, MAX(CASE WHEN sale_year = 2018 THEN median_price * (cpi_2025.cpi_2025 / cpi_year) END) AS median_2018_adj FROM median_by_year, cpi_2025) t;"}
